title: Add site Design system popup: a demo on another host than tracy-web's gets the static worn page, not an unworn live frame
steps: S1: Run the door test file apps/tracy-web/test/design-system-preview-door.test.mjs, filtered to the case named 'another host'.
expect: S1: the case passes: live=1 for a demo whose host is not the server's answers text/html carrying tracy-ds-slot, and a demo on the server's host still answers the live JSON.
evidence: 18/10/2026 on dev: the popup for JA Vega/Tour/Morgan (demos on fleet01) framed the demo with no tracy-ds-slot; fleet01 serves them straight through its tunnel, never through the site proxy that lays the system in
fence: The preview door's liveServed gate (demo.host === config.hostName) before the live frame
